summary:
FIELDWISE AI is a NASA-powered agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers make smarter, sustainable, and climate-resilient crop rotation decisions. Unlike traditional systems that recommend crops for a single season, FIELDWISE evaluates complete three-season crop rotations based on soil conditions, water availability, historical climate patterns, and farmer priorities.

The platform utilizes approximately 30 years of NASA POWER meteorological data and integrates NASA GPM/IMERG precipitation data for additional rainfall insights when available. Its Historical Climate Replay Engine evaluates crop rotations against past weather conditions, while its What-If Simulation Engine explores potential impacts of drought, extreme heat, and heavy rainfall.

FIELDWISE also offers explainable crop recommendations, multi-objective rotation scoring, interactive visualizations, and downloadable Farmer Cards. Built using Python, Flask, and JavaScript, the platform transforms complex Earth observation data into practical agricultural insights, helping farmers compare strategies, understand climate risks, and make informed decisions toward sustainable agriculture.
details:
FIELDWISE AI is a NASA-powered crop rotation advisory platform that helps farmers make sustainable, climate-resilient decisions. It uses 30 years of NASA POWER climate data and supports GPM/IMERG rainfall observations to evaluate three-season crop rotations based on soil, water availability, and climate conditions.

Its key features include historical climate replay, drought and heat simulations, explainable crop recommendations, and interactive visualizations. Built using Python, Flask, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Pandas, FIELDWISE transforms complex satellite data into practical farming insights.

Our goal is to improve water efficiency, promote sustainable agriculture, and help farmers make informed decisions while accounting for climate uncertainty.
